title: Whispers of the Pale Garden
description:
a mod that adds various new additions to the pale garden biome.
you can report bugs in the discord server.
body:
The Pale Garden is a total aesthetic and atmospheric overhaul of an existing biome, transforming it into a mist-covered dreamscape. Once familiar terrain is now overgrown with faded flora and bathed in cold, diffused light. Colors are soft and desaturated, as if seen through a veil of memory — turning the ordinary into the uncanny.

With this mod, the biome becomes a place of quiet melancholy and strange peace — not dead, but sleepwalking through time. Whether stumbled upon or deliberately sought out, the Pale Garden lingers in the mind like a half-remembered dream.
